jobs.description: Oxy produces , markets and transports oil and natural gas to maximize value and provide resources fundamental to life. The company leverages its global leadership in carbon management to advance lower-carbon technologies and products. Headquartered in Houston, Oxy primarily operates in the United States, Middle East and North Africa. To learn more, visit Oxy Oxy strives to attract and retain talented employees by investing in their professional development and providing rewarding opportunities for personal growth. Our goal is to meet the highest employer standards by ensuring the health and safety of our employees, protecting the environment and positively impacting our communities where we do business. The UAS Operations Team Leader is responsible for the leadership, daily management, and continuous advancement of the organization's internal unmanned aircraft systems (UAS/drone) program. This role serves as the primary technical authority and operational leader for all drone-based activities supporting Oxy’s oil and gas operations including, facility and well pad imaging, pipeline and midstream infrastructure inspections, drone based compliance inspections, electrical transmission and distribution asset imaging and inspections, offshore inspections, and related industrial inspection programs. The Team Leader ensures all UAS operations are executed to the standards and procedure set forth by Oxy and result in safe, efficient, and compliant day to day operations. This individual manages a team of certified pilots and mission specialists, maintains a multi-platform fleet of UAS infrastructure, drives capability development, interfaces with internal stakeholders and is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of actionable inspection data and analytical products to operations, asset integrity, and engineering teams. Core Responsibilities: Safety and Compliance Serve as the primary safety authority for all UAS operations, establishing and enforcing a comprehensive Safety Management System (SMS) aligned with company HSE and Aviation policies and industry best practices. Ensure full compliance with FAA Part 107 regulations, BVLOS waivers, COAs, and any applicable international aviation authority requirements for cross-border or offshore operations. Develop, maintain , and enforce UAS-specific Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Emergency Response Procedures (ERPs), and Mission Risk Assessments (MRAs) for all operation types. Improve upon and support pre-mission hazard identification and risk mitigation processes, including airspace conflict analysis, weather assessment, electromagnetic interference evaluation, and site-specific hazard reviews. Maintain thorough incident investigation protocols; lead or delegate root cause analysis and corrective action implementation for any UAS-related incident, near-miss, or equipment loss. Enforce strict adherence to Process Safety Management (PSM) and OSHA regulations when operating in and around hazardous energy environments (refineries, compressor stations, tank farms, gas plants). Ensure pilots and crew maintain current certifications, medical fitness (where applicable), and substance abuse compliance per company policy. Fleet and Asset Management Own the full lifecycle management of the UAS fleet, including sensor packages and associated payloads. Establish procurement, maintenance, and end-of-life procedures Work with management to establish routine refreshes of critical equipment to ensure fleet and mission readiness Develop and enforce scheduled preventive maintenance programs, component lifecycle tracking (motor hours, prop cycles, battery charge cycles), and mandatory inspection intervals for each platform class. Oversee firmware and software updates across the fleet, evaluating and validating changes in a controlled test environment prior to operational deployment. Manage payload inventory including RGB cameras, lighting kits, radiometric thermal imagers, LiDAR scanners, methane/gas detection sensors Manage secure transport, storage, and readiness of equipment for rapid field deployment including cases, charging infrastructure, and environmental storage requirements. Maintain insurance documentation and records for all airframes; interface with risk management and aviation as needed. Pilot Management and Training Recruit, hire, onboard, and manage a team of FAA Part 107-certified UAS pilots and mission specialists, ensuring adequate coverage for operational demand across multiple simultaneous campaigns. Develop and administer a structured internal pilot proficiency program encompassing initial qualification, platform type ratings, mission category endorsements, and annual recurrency requirements. Conduct regular proficiency evaluations, standardization flights, and documented check for all pilots; maintain individual pilot training records and currency logs. Ensure training programs exists and are available for fleet pilots and staff pilots Establish a mentorship and career progression pathway for junior pilots to advance to mission-lead and senior pilot roles. Train pilots and data technicians on data collection protocols, payload operation, sensor calibration, etc. Identify and manage approved external training providers and recurrency programs to supplement internal capability development. Administer performance reviews, identify skill gaps, and implement individual development plans for all direct reports as needed. Foster a culture of continuous learning, safety-first decision-making, and operational excellence across the entire UAS team. Day-to-Day Operations Management Oversee and direct all daily UAS flight operations including pre-mission planning, mission execution, post-mission data processing, and associated debriefs. Coordinate with site operations, mechanical integrity, HSE, pipeline integrity, facilities maintenance, and electrical transmission teams to align drone mission execution with site access, permit-to-work (PTW), and operational windows. Manage simultaneous field campaigns across multiple asset types and geographies, including remote pipeline corridors, offshore platforms, tank batteries, compressor stations, substations, and transmission towers. Ensure all flight operations are logged in a digital operations management system, capturing flight hours, battery cycles, anomalies, and personnel records in compliance with FAA and company documentation requirements. Monitor real-time weather conditions, NOTAMs, TFRs, and airspace status for all active and planned operation areas; make go/no-go decisions with appropriate authority . Establish and enforce strict pre-flight checklists, mission briefing standards, and post-flight debrief protocols. Scheduling, Backlog Management & Prioritization Maintain and communicate a rolling backlog and mission queue integrating requests from multiple internal customers including asset integrity, pipeline operations, electrical transmission, HSE, and engineering. Design and implement a structured intake and prioritization framework that accounts for regulatory inspection intervals, risk-ranked asset criticality, operational urgency, weather windows, and resource availability. Build and manage a detailed master schedule for all UAS operations, balancing planned inspection programs, reactive/emergency response deployments, and capability development activities. Produce monthly and quarterly operational forecasts for crew utilization , flight hours, equipment usage, and data delivery timelines; communicate proactively with stakeholders on scheduling constraints. Triage and respond to unplanned inspection requests (e.g., leak detection, post-storm damage assessment, pre-turnaround surveys, incident response support) with rapid mobilization capability. Coordinate with planning and maintenance departments to align UAS access windows with planned outages, turnarounds, maintenance campaigns, and construction activities to maximize operational efficiency. Track open work orders and inspection assignments to completion, escalating blockers and resource conflicts to management with clear recommendations. Maintain KPI dashboards tracking planned vs. actual flight hours, mission completion rates, backlog age, schedule adherence, and data delivery cycle times. Data Processing, Management and Delivery Work and coordinate with support staff to ensure a robust data pipeline from raw sensor capture through processing, quality assurance, and delivery to end-user stakeholders. Manage delivery of data products to GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS), asset management systems (SAP PM ) and inspection management platforms. Seek ways to integrate UAS data, images and findings into standardized workflows. Work with support staff to ensure data governance standards including file naming conventions, metadata tagging, coordinate reference system (CRS) management, and long-term archive and retrieval procedures. Work with support staff to ensure QA/QC processes for all data deliverables, including independent review protocols and defect detection validation against manual inspection findings where available. Track data delivery SLAs against stakeholder commitments; report on turnaround time KPIs and identify bottlenecks in the processing workflow. Capabilities Development and Innovation Lead the research, evaluation, and integration of emerging UAS technologies, including advanced payload sensors, autonomous/semi-autonomous flight systems, AI-assisted detection, and drone dock systems. Develop business cases and ROI analyses for new capability investments, comparing drone-based approaches against traditional inspection methods in terms of cost, cycle time, data quality, and safety risk reduction. Work with relevant teams to evaluate AI/ML-powered automated recognition platforms for integration into the inspection data workflow. Develop and socialize internal technical standards for UAS-based inspection methodologies and data products to achieve consistency across asset classes and operating regions. Recruitment Fraud It has come to our attention various individuals and/or organizations are contacting people falsely pretending to recruit on behalf of Oxy. Please be aware that these recruiting scams and communications do not originate nor are they associated with our recruitment process. All Oxy job postings and offers will require a completed application through our company website. Oxy does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruiting process. We will never: • Ask you to pay for applications, interviews, meetings, processing, training or for any other fees • Use recruiting or placement agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind or • Request personal information such as passport and bank account details at an early stage of our recruitment process. We recommend against responding to unsolicited business propositions or offers from people you don't know. Do not disclose your personal or financial details. If you believe you have been the victim of a recruiting scam, please contact your local police department. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

Why PlayStation?

PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, PlayStation®VR, PlayStation®Plus, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.

PlayStation also strives to create an inclusive environment that empowers employees and embraces diversity. We welcome and encourage everyone who has a passion and curiosity for innovation, technology, and play to explore our open positions and join our growing global team.

The PlayStation brand falls under Sony Interactive Entertainment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.

概要
PlayStationの新製品、既存製品、サービス、コンソール外体験のユーザーエクスペリエンスを開発するチームに所属する、PlayStationのUXライターを募集します。UXライターは、機能の仕様、スタイルガイド、ビジネス目標、包括的なUXフィロソフィーを踏まえて、品質の高いUIメッセージを作成する業務です。製品開発の初期段階では、グルーミングやUXデザインセッションに積極的に参加し、建設的なフィードバックを提供します。UXデザイナーと協業しながらライティングプロセスを繰り返し、ステイクホルダーおよびパートナーの承認を得ます。作成したUIメッセージは必要十分な情報を加えてローカリゼーションチームに引き渡します。

このUXライター IIのポジションでは、当社のコア製品、サービスエコシステム内のさまざまな機能を対象とします。あらゆる立場のプレイヤーやユーザーのために、デザイン思考を活用してライティングを行います。コンソール、モバイル、ウェブ、PCなどで表示されるコピーは、数十の言語にローカライズされるため、多角的、多文化的な視点も求められます。そういった意味では、ブログや技術文書といった、長文の整ったテキストを作成する技術ももちろん重要ですが、製品開発に関わるステークホルダーとのコミュニケーションスキルと、コミュニケーションに基づいて高品質なUIメッセージを作成するライティングスキル、そしてこれらを通じて製品の体験を向上させるインタラクティブ体験設計のスキルがより重要となります。

当社のUXライターは、創造的かつ戦術的な観点で、問題解決を図ります。ライティングガイドの規定に準じ、トーンオブボイスガイドを踏まえ、承認された用語を使用してUIコピーを作成します。作成にあたっては、シニアUXライターやマネージャーからの指示を受けます。作成したメッセージはUXライティングチームの他のメンバーによってレビューされます。

プロジェクトは複数のプラットフォームにまたがり、複数のプロジェクトを同時並行で進めるため、業務をのプロダクトが、異なるスケジュールで、複数のスケジュールで複数の製品を扱うため、計画性をもって順序立てて業務を遂行するスキルが求められます。エンジニア、デザイナー、ローカリゼーションマネージャー、プロダクトオーナーなど、さまざまな文化的背景を持つメンバーと定期的に協力するため、コミュニケーションスキルも重要視されます。また、ツールやプロセスの改善に積極的に貢献する意欲も必要です。

雇用形態
契約社員（契約期間1年／1日8時間勤務／正社員登用制度あり）

資格要件

• 3年以上のライティングまたは編集経験。インタラクティブなプロダクト、マーケティング、テクニカルライティング、商業誌の編集など、職業としてのライティングまたは編集業務に3年以上就業していること。
• 商業レベルでの日本語または英語のライティング能力。
• ネイティブ日本語話者の場合、商業レベルでの日本語ライティング能力を持ち、ビジネスレベル以上の英語スキル（読む、書く、話す、聞く）が必須です。
• ネイティブ英語話者の場合、商業レベルでの英語ライティング能力を持ち、優れた日本語スキル（読む、書く、話す、聞く）が必須です。
• 優れたコミュニケーションおよびコラボレーション能力。他者と連携しながら業務を進める能力が必要です。また、業務を指定された期間内に完了させてきた実績も必要です。
• スタイルガイドやブランドトーンへの準拠。スタイルガイドやブランドのトーンオブボイスに従い、仕様に準拠した執筆ができる技術が求められます。
• マルチタスクをこなす組織的な能力。複数のプロジェクトやその進捗状況を把握しながら、効率的かつ熱心にタスクを進める能力が必要です。
• 社内ツールの迅速な習得および活用能力。CMS、フロー管理ツール、プロジェクト追跡ツール、社内コミュニケーションツールなど、業務に必要な各種ツールを迅速に習得し、活用できること。
• 担当製品に関する専門知識。製品や機能に関する知識を持ち、新製品や新機能の評価、開発に役立つ建設的な提案ができる能力が求められます。
• ブランド擁護とビジネス目標への貢献意欲。多様なチームと協力しながら、ブランドを後押しし、ビジネス目標を達成する意欲が必要です。
• 複数言語に対応するメッセージ作成経験。メッセージを複数の言語にローカライズする際に適応できるスキルや経験が求められます。
• ユーザーエクスペリエンスに関する知識と実務経験。ユーザーエクスペリエンスに関する専門知識を有し、実務での応用経験があること。
• デザインおよびレイアウトに関する知識と経験。デザインやレイアウトの原則を理解し、実務に反映できるスキルが求められます。
• チームメンバーとのコラボレーションを楽しむ姿勢。チームの雰囲気を盛り上げながら、他のメンバーと協力して仕事を進める姿勢が必要です。

望ましい条件望ましい条件

• テクノロジー業界での実務経験
• B2C志向での業務経験
• ウェブ、モバイル、およびその他のデバイスにおける新技術への関心
• アジャイルソフトウェア開発プロセスに精通していること
• Figmaでのコラボレーション、テキスト編集、またはデザインの経験
• 過去の実績を示すポートフォリオまたは個人ウェブサイトを持つ方
• ビデオゲーム業界に関する堅実な知識

Construisez l'avenir d'Amazon dès la première pierre.

Nous lançons un nouveau site à Derval (entre Rennes et Nantes) en septembre 2027, et tout reste à bâtir. Dès le premier jour, vous serez au cœur de l'action : de l'installation des équipements à la définition des premiers standards opérationnels, vous poserez les fondations de ce qui deviendra un maillon essentiel de notre réseau logistique.

Pour en savoir un pue plus, voici un article qui parle du projet !: https://www.aboutamazon.fr/actualites/activite-logistique/amazon-annonce-la-construction-de-son-premier-centre-de-distribution-dans-la-region-pays-de-la-loire-a-derval-loire-atlantique-qui-creera-1-000-emplois-en-cdi

Au sein de l'équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering), vous intégrerez le moteur de l'innovation chez Amazon. Notre mission ? Faire en sorte que chaque outil, chaque technologie, chaque système évolue au rythme d'Amazon pour garantir que des millions de clients reçovent leurs commandes à temps, chaque jour.

En tant que Responsable Maintenance Industrielle & Robotique, vous dirigerez une équipe de superviseurs et de techniciens expérimentés. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où l'excellence opérationnelle n'est pas une ambition, mais une exigence et où chacune de vos décisions impacte directement la satisfaction de nos clients.

Si vous êtes passionné(e) par les défis techniques de haut niveau, le management d'équipes expertes et l'innovation concrète au quotidien, alors ce poste est fait pour vous.

Key job responsibilities
- Assurer la santé et la sécurité de votre équipe : Déployer une culture de sécurité exemplaire (protocoles LOTO, Safety Curriculum, toolbox talks), maintenir l'objectif zéro incident grave, et faire de la santé et sécurité un levier de performance durable sur votre site
- Développer et faire grandir vos talents : Coacher techniciens, superviseurs et apprentis dans leur progression, piloter les programmes RMEO et d'apprentissage, et créer un environnement où chacun se sent soutenu et reconnu
- Garantir l'excellence opérationnelle : Piloter la disponibilité technique des équipements (objectif >99%), planifier la maintenance préventive dans le cadre des processus établis, et contribuer à la réduction des High Impact Events et False Fire Alarms
- Piloter l'amélioration continue et l'innovation : Exploiter les outils d'IA (dont Quartz, notre agent IA de diagnostic déployé sur 600+ sites dans le monde), analyser les données pour identifier les opportunités d'optimisation, et mener des projets Kaizen/QCC en lien avec les équipes européennes
- Gérer les projets et les parties prenantes : Collaborer avec les équipes internes (GES, GPO, Central RME) et les fournisseurs tiers, élaborer des plans opérationnels pour améliorer la productivité et l'efficacité dans le cadre des objectifs du réseau

A day in the life
Vous serez basé·e sur l’un de nos sites opérationnels, ce qui vous permettra d’être au plus près de votre équipe et d’avoir une vision claire de ce qui se passe sur votre site. Vous collecterez des données et résoudrez les problèmes dans un environnement dynamique. Vous aurez également l’occasion d’élaborer un plan opérationnel visant à rendre le site plus productif et plus efficace. Vous devrez notamment mettre en place de nouveaux projets visant à améliorer les processus opérationnels et l’entretien du matériel. Après la sécurité, la fonction la plus importante de votre rôle consistera à diriger votre équipe et à gérer ses performances et son évolution, notamment en mettant en place des formations.

About the team
Notre équipe d’ingénieurs RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) veille à ce que nos équipements fonctionnent au mieux. Guidés par des responsables expérimentés, nous sommes une équipe à l’esprit analytique. Nos collaborateurs·trices possèdent à la fois des connaissances techniques poussées et un bon esprit d’équipe. Nous travaillons ensemble pour assurer l’entretien, le dépannage et la réparation des ressources de notre réseau mondial de centres d’expédition. Certains de nos employé·es occupent des postes à responsabilités et sont chargés de superviser l’équipe dans son travail sur des technologies passionnantes, dont certaines n’existent que chez Amazon.
De l’installation de systèmes d’emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d’un site, en passant par la réparation d’équipements de distribution essentiels, notre équipe assure le bon fonctionnement de la plupart des éléments techniques d’Amazon. Nous veillons, par exemple, à ce que les bâtiments soient conformes à la législation, afin d’assurer la sécurité de tous et le fonctionnement à plein régime de nos sites. Les possibilités d’évolution sont nombreuses, tant au sein de l’équipe RME qu’à l’échelle d’Amazon.
Tout ce que nous faisons vise à réduire les temps d’arrêt dans les principaux sites logistiques d’Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps. Nous travaillons souvent tôt ou tard pour effectuer les tâches de maintenance avec un minimum de perturbations, y compris en équipes de nuit. Si nous voyons qu’il existe une méthodologie plus aboutie pour faire les choses, nous avons les compétences nécessaires pour développer et introduire des processus nouveaux ou des technologies de pointe, comme Amazon Robotics ou notre robot de tri ultra sophistiqué.

jobs.description: About this role Your team Fundamental Equities sits within BlackRock's Portfolio Management Group and provides clients with a broad range of actively managed, high-conviction equity strategies. Through a hybrid research model, investment professionals work closely across regions and sectors to identify opportunities and deliver long-term value for clients. Your role and impact This Associate Core Portfolio Manager role supports the United States equity investment team within Fundamental Equities. The position plays a critical role in implementing investment decisions, supporting portfolio construction activities, maintaining strong governance and controls, and ensuring efficient execution of portfolio-management processes. The successful candidate will partner with portfolio managers, trading teams, product strategists, and operational stakeholders while helping to enhance workflows through data, automation, and technology-enabled solutions. Leverage financial-market knowledge, investment-platform applications, and technical capabilities to improve workflows and develop scalable solutions. Collaborate with portfolio managers, product strategists, trading teams, client businesses, and operational support partners on a daily basis to support investment objectives. Your experience Demonstrated experience in a finance or technology-related role and relevant academic background in business, finance, computing, financial engineering, or a related field. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively across a global team and credibly represent portfolio-manager perspectives. Familiarity with data-visualization reporting tools used to communicate insights from complex datasets. Interest in using artificial intelligence (AI) and emerging technologies to improve productivity, generate insights, and support scalable investment processes. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com . We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn , Instagram , YouTube , X , and TikTok . We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law. jobs.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) has the most services and more features within those services, than any other cloud provider – from infrastructure technologies like compute, storage, and databases – to emerging technologies, such as machine learning and artificial intelligence, data lakes and analytics, and Internet of Things. ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI Consumer Devices is building the next generation of products that bring powerful AI into people’s everyday lives. The Operating Systems team is critical in this mission, turning sophisticated hardware and AI capabilities into a reliable, trusted platform. Security is central to that work: we define trust boundaries, integrate hardware-backed protections, isolate sensitive context, and establish the guardrails that let AI applications and agents act safely, privately, and under user control.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Software Security Architect to define the security architecture for OpenAI’s next-generation operating system. You’ll work alongside hardware security architects and partner with operating system, silicon, firmware, privacy, and product teams to protect users, their devices, and their data.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can connect operating system internals, hardware-backed security, and real-world product constraints. Your work will shape the platform’s trust model, protect sensitive information, and set the technical foundations for AI that is safe, private, and under user control.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Define the operating system’s security architecture, trust boundaries, privilege model, and protections for sensitive user data.

- Partner with hardware security architects to integrate roots of trust, secure elements, trusted execution environments, and processor security capabilities into the operating system.

- Design foundational platform defenses, including secure boot, code signing, attestation, secure updates, key protection, and device recovery.

- Establish isolation and access controls across the kernel, applications, system services, and AI workloads.

- Define guardrails for how AI applications and agents access information, use sensors and tools, retain context, and act on a user’s behalf.

- Lead threat modeling and architecture reviews across the platform, translating emerging threats into practical, enforceable requirements.

- Prototype solutions, review security-critical systems code, and guide engineering teams through complex technical and product tradeoffs.

- Deep experience designing or securing operating systems, kernels, embedded platforms, hypervisors, or other privileged systems software.

- Complex understanding of operating system internals, including memory protection, process isolation, executable loading, device drivers, and privilege boundaries.

- Experience building security architectures that span hardware, firmware, operating systems, applications, and cloud services.

- Bring practical expertise in secure boot, code signing, device identity, attestation, trusted execution, and hardware-backed key protection.

- Can write or review systems code in C, C++, Rust, or comparable languages, with a strong grasp of secure development and exploit mitigation.

- Build rigorous threat models, influence cross-functional engineering teams, and communicate security tradeoffs clearly.

- Care deeply about user privacy, personal agency, and building systems that earn trust through their design.

- Shipping security technologies for consumer operating systems, mobile platforms, or connected devices.

- Kernel hardening, memory-safety mitigations, virtualization-based security, or secure enclave integration.

- Security architecture for AI agents, sensitive-context isolation, permissioned tool use, or prompt-injection resistance.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡(주)의 ER팀은 노무관리 업무를 담당하는 부서입니다.
근로감독 및 노동분쟁 사건에 대응하고, 취업규칙 등 사내 제규정 관리와 임직원 대상 노무 교육을 운영하며, 포상·징계 심의를 위한 인사위원회 운영과 관련 이력 관리를 담당합니다. 또한, 집단적 노사 관계 관리와 사내 공식 소통 채널 운영을 통해 조직별 노무관리 체계를 구축하고 임직원 소통을 지원하며, 조직별 사건·사고 대응, 조직 문화 이벤트 운영, 기타 노무 관련 사항 지원 등 전반적인 노무관리 업무를 수행하고 있습니다.

About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Overview:

The Acceptance Solutions team is part of the Value-Added Services (VAS) organization and is responsible for enabling and growing acceptance products and services across the CEMEA region.

This role will be responsible for leading Visa's acceptance localization strategy and execution across Central and Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (CEMEA. The role will drive the identification, prioritization, and delivery of localization requirements necessary to support domestic payment schemes, national payment infrastructure initiatives, local routing mandates, regulatory requirements, and market-specific acceptance needs.

The successful candidate will serve as the CEMEA subject matter expert for card-present acceptance localization and will work closely with regulators, national payment companies, financial institutions, acquirers, processors, merchants, and internal Visa stakeholders to ensure Visa's in-person acceptance capabilities support local market requirements and evolving payment ecosystem needs.

This role will partner extensively with Global Product teams, Core Processing and Network teams, Technology teams, Government Engagement, Legal, Risk, and Compliance organizations to assess market requirements, define product and processing enhancements, influence product roadmaps, and drive the delivery of localization initiatives across the acceptance ecosystem.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing regional localization strategies, conducting market and regulatory assessments, translating local requirements into actionable business and technical specifications, supporting client engagements, and ensuring successful deployment of localized acceptance capabilities across CEMEA markets.

This position would be ideal for a candidate with extensive experience in merchant acquiring, payment acceptance, payment processing, domestic payment schemes, regulatory programs, or in-person payments product management. The role is part of the hub team covering the CEMEA region and will report to the Acceptance Solutions Lead within the VAS organization.

Key Responsibilities:

• Be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for in-person acceptance localization across CEMEA, covering merchant acquiring, acceptance infrastructure, card-present payments, domestic payment schemes, and local routing initiatives.
• Lead Visa's regional strategy for localization of in-person acceptance capabilities to address regulatory requirements, domestic payment scheme mandates, and national payment infrastructure initiatives.
• Analyze and translate regulatory, market, and domestic scheme requirements into clearly documented business, operational, and technical requirements.
• Partner with regulators, central banks, national payment companies, and government stakeholders to understand evolving payment ecosystem requirements and represent Visa's acceptance capabilities.
• Work closely with Government Engagement, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Regional Product teams to assess the impact of local payment requirements and define Visa's response strategy.
• Collaborate with Global Product, Technology, Acceptance Solutions, and Core Processing teams to build business cases, prioritize market requirements, and drive product roadmap enhancements.
• Partner with VisaNet, network processing, and core processing teams to evaluate technical implications of localization initiatives and identify scalable implementation approaches.
• Drive end-to-end execution of localization initiatives including requirements gathering, impact assessments, stakeholder alignment, business case development, delivery tracking, testing, certification support, and market readiness activities.
• Support domestic payment scheme enablement initiatives, including co-badging programs, local routing, domestic acceptance mandates, and national payment infrastructure projects.
• Assess acquiring, processing, and acceptance ecosystem readiness to support market-specific payment requirements.
• Engage with acquirers, processors, payment service providers (PSPs), payment facilitators, terminal vendors, merchants, fintechs, and ecosystem participants to understand implementation challenges and support deployment readiness.
• Identify product gaps and regional customization requirements and work with global teams to prioritize and deliver solutions addressing local market needs.
• Develop market assessments, strategy recommendations, and executive-level updates to support regional and global decision-making.
• Be responsible for annual planning activities for localization initiatives, including KPI setting, strategic priorities, delivery objectives, and cross-functional alignment.
• Monitor progress of localization programs and provide regular updates to senior leadership on market readiness, implementation status, risks, and dependencies.
• Represent Visa at industry forums, regulatory discussions, market working groups, and client engagements related to payment acceptance, domestic schemes, and localization initiatives.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Finance, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in payments, merchant acquiring, card-present acceptance, payment processing, fintech, or related industries.
• Deep expertise in merchant acquiring, payment acceptance ecosystems, and card-present payment processing.
• Proven experience working with financial institutions, acquirers, processors, payment service providers, merchants, fintechs, payment networks, or national payment organizations.
• Strong knowledge of card-present payments, including:

• EMV chip acceptance
• Contactless payments
• NFC technologies
• SoftPOS / Tap-to-Phone
• Android POS
• Unattended commerce
• Transit acceptance
• Mobile wallet acceptance
• QR-based acceptance solutions

• Strong understanding of payment processing and transaction lifecycles, including authorization, clearing, settlement, routing, switching, and acquiring architectures.
• Working knowledge of payment technologies and standards including ISO 8583, EMV specifications, contactless frameworks, tokenization concepts, terminal certification processes, and network routing models.
• Demonstrated experience supporting payment localization initiatives, domestic payment schemes, local routing programs, regulatory projects, or national payment infrastructure modernization efforts.
• Strong understanding of the payments landscape across GCC and broader CEMEA markets, including domestic schemes, regulatory frameworks, national payment infrastructure, and local routing requirements.
• Experience working with regulators, central banks, national payment companies, or government stakeholders is strongly preferred.
• Familiarity with leading acquiring and payment processing platforms such as OpenWay, BPC, Compass Plus, ACI, Fiserv, or equivalent solutions is strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to translate market requirements into product, technology, and operational deliverables.
• Experience driving complex cross-functional programs involving business, product, technology, legal, regulatory, and external stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and ability to develop business cases and strategic recommendations.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and program management skills.
• Ability to communicate complex technical and business concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives in a fast-paced and highly matrixed environment.
• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior executives, clients, regulators, and industry partners.
• Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills to support strategy development, business cases, executive communications, and market assessments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Arabic.
• Ability to travel across GCC and CEMEA markets as required.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. jobs.description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.
